sentences.text: Shri K. K. Tiwari - Govt. Advocate for the respondent/

S 
Heard on I.A.No.5926/2024, which is an application under Section 389 (1) of the Cr.P.C. seeking
temporary suspension of jail sentence of the appellant
- Mahadev son of Motilal Patidar .

The appellant/accused has been undergoing sentence under:- Section 376(D) of IPC and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment for the remainder of appellant/accused natural life with fine of Rs.
5,000/-, Section 342 of IPC and sentenced to undergo 01 year R.I with fine of Rs.1,000/-, Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA),1989 and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.5,000/-,
Section 419 of IPC and sentenced to undergo 03 years R.I with fine of Rs.5,000/- alongwith default stipulations respectively.

Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the temporary suspension has been filed on the ground of marriage of appellant's son Omprakash scheduled to be solemnized on 21.04.2024 to 22.04.2024 at village Petlawad, Tehsil Dharampuri, District Dhar (M.P).
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.
We have heard both the parties and perused the record.
Considering the fact that mother of the bride is alive and for the marriage ceremony the presence of appellant/accused being father is not indispensable.
Therefore, no ground is made out to enlarge the appellant on temporary bail.
(S. A. DHARMADHIKARI) (GAJE  JUDGE   akanksha Mahadev vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56582992/
